An '''operative''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] faked his [[Death/Legends|death]] to escape Imperial service while working undercover on [[Jocal Four]]<ref name="TOR" /> by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Missing Operative" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the opposing sides in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent a companion of theirs to investigate the missing agent's disappearance. The companion discovered that the operative had faked his death to escape the Empire and retrieved his mission notes.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial operative was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Missing Operative" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
